Class MetadataViewerDialog

  • java.lang.Object
    • javafx.stage.Window
      • javafx.stage.Stage
        • gui.MetadataViewerDialog
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    javafx.event.EventTarget

    class MetadataViewerDialog
extends javafx.stage.Stage
    Modal dialog that presents extracted metadata using both a structured TreeTableView and a flat raw text representation within the original toolbar layout.

      • exportToFile

        private void exportToFile()
        Prompts the user with a FileChooser dialog to save the flat text metadata to a file. Defaults to the user's home directory with a pre-populated file name containing the system hostname. Launches an error popup via GUIUtils.launchPopup(javafx.stage.Window, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType) if writing fails or is interrupted.
